clavicular_cartilage_coverage_percent.location: Anteroinferior medial end, including inferior/underside contact with manubrial and first-rib cartilage. Not uniform coverage of the whole end.

SC_disc_thickness_mm.definition: Reported thickness of tapered, biconcave intra-articular disc; not a uniform neutral joint gap or bone-to-bone spacing.

required_distinct_landmarks: medial clavicular osseous envelope and its centroid
clavicular articular cartilage patch and explicitly defined surface centre
manubrial articular cartilage patch and explicitly defined surface centre
SC intra-articular disc with two contact interfaces
kinematic SC reference/instantaneous axis, separately justified
prohibited_shortcuts: Substitute whole bone-head centroid for Qiu articular-surface centre.
Set bilateral SC breadth from clavicular AP diameter.
Use pooled disc thickness as constant SC gap or add it directly to chord length.
Convert confidence intervals of a mean into SD/range of individuals.
Count cartilage/disc as extra anatomical bones.
Collapse SC, AC and GH references.
topology_requirement: Retain one clavicle per side and existing 206-bone inventory; cartilage/disc/contact helpers are non-bone. SC connects shoulder girdle to manubrium/first-costal-cartilage relationship; separate AC/GH and scapulothoracic relationships persist.
blockers: No paired bilateral SC centre coordinates relative to body centreline or manubrial notch.
No male/stature-conditioned cartilage-patch envelope, disc neutral deformation or instantaneous-centre mapping.
Absolute canonical thorax pose and independent matched replication remain required.
next_safe_action: Use digitized articular/contact patches when accessible; solve contact and coordinate-frame constraints before selecting global SC/AC. Keep contact context separate from target selection.
